launch_core_engines: launch vLLM core engine processes with ZMQ addresses and data parallel configuration
create_dp_placement_groups: create Ray placement groups for data parallel engine distribution across nodes
wait_for_engine_startup: wait for core engine processes to send HELLO and READY handshake messages
get_engine_zmq_addresses: allocate ZMQ input and output socket addresses for engine-client communication
monitor_engine_liveness: monitor engine core process liveness and trigger shutdown on unexpected exit
